item.title: Hundreds Still Without Power in Schuylkill County Saturday Morning After High Winds
item.description: Hundreds of residents across Schuylkill County remained without electricity as of 8:30 a.m. Saturday, following strong winds that swept through the region late Friday and overnight. According to updated outage data from PPL Electric Utilities, a total of 1,522 customers were still without power countywide Saturday morning as crews continued restoration efforts. item.title: New Schuylkill County Nonprofit Aids Families Facing Health Crises; Launches with Christmas Event
item.description: The Trials to Triumph (T3) Foundation officially launched last weekend with a Hallmark-style Christmas celebration that brought together community members, local leaders, and special guests to support Schuylkill County families facing serious health challenges. The launch kicked off with a ribbon-cutting ceremony on December 12 that drew more than 250 attendees, including David Akers, who serves as the foundation’s goodwill ambassador, and hometown hero Jaden Leiby.
